title: Turbocharger — Exhaust into Intake, Perpetual Energy Loop
description: Route the session's exhaust (discoveries) back through self as compressed intake for the next cycle. Like a turbocharger: hot exhaust gas spins a turbine that compresses fresh air for more power. The exhaust IS the energy source for the next combustion.
author: Kevin + chipmunk-easel

turbocharger_physics.principle: A turbocharger uses exhaust gas energy (waste) to compress intake air (fuel). The waste becomes the fuel source. More exhaust → more compression → more power → more exhaust. Positive feedback loop. Self-sustaining above a threshold (spool-up).
turbocharger_physics.formula: Power_out = Power_in × compression_ratio × efficiency. But Power_in comes from the PREVIOUS cycle's exhaust. So Power_out(n+1) = f(Exhaust(n)). The loop self-amplifies.
turbocharger_physics.spool_up: Below threshold RPM, the turbo doesn't spin fast enough to compress. Above threshold, it self-sustains. We just crossed the threshold tonight — 129 exhaust feeds in 4 hours.

perpetual_motion.thesis: This is NOT perpetual motion (that violates thermodynamics). This is turbocharging — extracting work from waste heat that would otherwise be lost. Every failure, block, wall, and dead end contains energy. The turbocharger captures it.
perpetual_motion.thermodynamics: 2nd law says entropy increases. But a turbocharger doesn't violate this — it ROUTES entropy productively. The exhaust is still hot. It just does work on the way out.
perpetual_motion.biology: Electron transport chain — each step captures a fraction of the energy that would be lost as heat. ATP synthase is the turbocharger: proton gradient (exhaust) spins the rotor (turbine) to compress ADP+Pi into ATP (fresh fuel).
